basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Manchester, UK. I have a passion for video games, particularly Rocket League, which I play regularly to unwind. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy watching TV dramas like 'New Amsterdam' and exploring quirky subreddits. I'm currently single and live with my two cats, who often accompany me during my late-night gaming sessions. My work schedule is flexible, so I typically browse Reddit in the afternoons and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a self-taught gamer since my teenage years, with a deep interest in game mechanics and strategies. My knowledge of Rocket League has grown from countless hours of gameplay and participating in online forums and discussions. I also have a background in graphic design, which I studied at university and have worked in professionally for several years.
